item.title: Blaine lawmaker proposing 'Harvey's Law' bill after Savage day care death
item.description: Minnesota lawmaker Nolan West is proposing a new bill at the state legislature called, "Harvey’s Law," in response to the death of an 11-month-old boy at a Savage day care last September.The proposed bill calls for cameras to be installed in infant and toddler rooms at any Minnesota day care center that receives state funding.
